messages:
sam: quick sync — we still have inconsistent status codes across routing/quota codepaths. noticed client saw 503 for throttling and 429 for quota, other places return 403 for quota. we should pick a single pattern and a structured error payload. thoughts?
jess: +1 we need a single canonical mapping. product needs stable codes for SDKs and error UX in the console.
tao: agree. from SRE side 503 has been used for transient capacity fallbacks (fallback to cheaper model), 429 for rate limiting, 403 for hard quota block. but that's confusing for clients — they treat 503 as retryable, which sometimes is wrong.
andrew: product POV: console UX expects a clear signal: is this user-blocking (do X in console) vs retry (auto-retry). so semantics must be deterministic. can we separate transport-level status from machine-readable error_code?
sam: proposal: keep HTTP statuses aligned with retry semantics only. i.e., 429 for client-side rate-limit (retry-after suggested), 503 for transient infra capacity (retry with backoff), 403 for quota permanently exceeded (requires tenant action). then add an "error_code" field with stable enums for programmatic handling (e.g., QUOTA_EXCEEDED, RATE_LIMIT, MODEL_FALLBACK, ROUTING_POLICY_DENIED).
jess: that sounds ok. we also need an "error_reason" and "user_message" for console display — short sentence and link to help center. can we standardize message templates?
tao: semantics look good. need to ensure routing layer maps internal reasons to these enums. tricky part: policy-driven denies (e.g., routing policy prohibits low-tier access to certain model) — should that be 403 or 429? it's not transient. 403 makes sense.
andrew: UX suggestion: include a small set of UI flags in the payload (string tags) like "action_required", "retryable", "show_in_console" — product can then decide. but keep them optional.
sam: sample error payload (draft):
```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error_code": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
  "error_reason": "monthly_token_quota",
  "message": "Your monthly token quota has been exceeded. Upgrade or wait until next billing period.",
  "help_url": "https://redwood.ai/docs/errors#quota_exceeded",
  "ui_tags": ["action_required","show_in_console"]
}
```
jess: looks good. one ask: make message short for console lines (60 chars) and add longer help page. also we need i18n pipeline later.
tao: telemetry: we must tag every error with routing_policy_id, model_variant, region, and a boolean "is_fallback". that'll help Optimize/Console correlate.
sam: agreed. logging/telemetry field names need to be stable across releases. let's add telemetry schema doc link to proposal.
andrew: rollout UX: we should ship this as an opt-in feature flag to not break older SDKs. new SDKs should fallback to status mapping if error_code missing. add deprecation schedule in changelog.
sam: @jess can you draft the console copy guidelines? include short vs long messages, help link patterns, and UI tag usage.
jess: ack. will draft and share by EOD tomorrow.
ta o: ack (typo) — will comment on PR with telemetry field names.
andrew: ack. will add SDK test plan in the PR template.
sam: thanks team. aim to have initial rollout on staging next week.
